def count_rotation(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    if n == 0:
        return 0

    # Find index of the minimum element
    lo, hi = 0, n - 1
    while lo < hi:
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        if arr[mid] > arr[hi]:
            lo = mid + 1
        else:
            hi = mid
    min_index = lo

    # Number of rotations = index of minimum measured from the end
    return n - min_index

assert count_rotation([3, 2, 1]) == 1
assert count_rotation([1, 2, 3]) == 0
